notes.title: UNILOGUE Ver3.5 - small patch
notes.notes:
Additions and Adjustments

 Adjusted Mist's skill: "Distribute 75 MP" => "Give 50 MP to all allies in the vicinity"
 Added some dialogue to Santa.


Bug fixes.

 Fixed a bug that prevented sorting of the character directory.
 Fixed display of programmatic characters in text, such as line breaks and special characters
 Fixed a bug where Nigana could be placed on high ground.

notes.title: UNILOGUE Ver3.4 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where Steam achievements would not register when clearing a stage.

notes.title: UNILOGUE Ver3.1 - small patch
notes.notes:
What's New

Confirmation at the end of the game
Save language settings in memory.
Progress in English translation (approx. 50% => 65%)


Balance changes

Skeet: Set maximum value passive HP increase
Shela: increased the hit detection of skills.


Bug fixes

Removed old elements left over from development.
